title: Echo rollout evaluation call
body:
Maria Costa: Month-end close takes us 11 days; we need it under 5 by the next audit.
Maria Costa: Dana, our CFO, signs anything over 25k and wants to see it first.
Maria Costa: It has to integrate with NetSuite, close in under five days and pass security review.
Maria Costa: There is some kind of review process, I would have to check.
Maria Costa: If this is still manual at the next audit we fail the control and the CFO takes the hit.
Maria Costa: I have already put this on the agenda for our ops review next week.
Maria Costa: We are also looking at BlackLine, mainly because our auditors already know it.
Ana Ruiz: Thanks, let us pick this up next time.
